notes.title: Clean up the world in Kingdoms of the Dump a SNES styled JRPG coming in November
notes.notes:
After a successful Kickstarter back in 2019, Roach Games have confirmed that Kingdoms of the Dump is set for release in November.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/clean-up-the-world-in-kingdoms-of-the-dump-a-snes-styled-jrpg-coming-in-november/
